name: julianosirtori-skills
description: Agent Skills by Juliano Sirtori. Each skill is a plain SKILL.md folder that also works in OpenCode, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and other agents.

plugins.name: mac-cleanup
plugins.description: Analyze and safely free up disk space on macOS: measures what uses storage, cleans only caches that rebuild themselves, finds leftovers of uninstalled apps and guides the removals that need your judgment.

plugins.name: squad
plugins.description: Run a feature, bug fix or refactor through a fast squad: a strong orchestrator writes the spec, contracts and a task board, fans implementation and tests out to up to 10 parallel Haiku workers, integrates, runs the checks and reviews, with Haiku QA and an independent Reviewer for large or risky changes, sized runs and capped fix loops.

plugins.name: product-naming
plugins.description: Find a brandable product or company name and check it can be owned: generates candidates in batches by strategy, bulk-checks domains straight from the registries (self-tested RDAP/whois), filters by meaning and sound in every market language, scores fit and marketing potential, and vets finalists (who owns a taken .com, search conflicts, USPTO/INPI/WIPO pre-screen, social handles).

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: End a session and continue in a fresh one without losing context: writes a self-contained handoff (goal, verified state, next steps, decisions, dead ends, user preferences, files to read, running processes, git snapshot) to .handoffs/, copies a short start prompt to the clipboard, and resumes by checking the handoff against the current code and git state.
